verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims built-in 'Auth for AI agents' with MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation. Its API Key plugin lets you create, manage, and verify keys (including organization-owned keys separate from users) with expirations and rate limits, and the MCP plugin lets an app act as an OAuth authorization server for agents. These give agents credentials distinct from a human's, but the evidence never documents per-key permission scoping or immediate revocation of agent credentials. missing for 10: documented per-agent least-privilege permission scopes on keys/tokens, documented instant revocation of agent credentials, in-depth docs on the agent-delegation feature, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give each agent its own least-privilege machine identity with narrowly scoped permissions and instant revocation, instead of sharing a human's credentials

citations.quote: Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.
